title: Up River Adventures

services.name: Horse & Buggy
services.desc: No prior riding experience is necessary! Our trail rides are designed for all skill levels, from complete beginners to experienced riders. Our friendly guides provide basic instruction and ensure you feel comfortable and confident before and throughout the journey. The gentle pace makes it perfect for first-time riders. Wear comfortable, weather-appropriate clothing that you don’t mind getting a little dusty. Closed-toe shoes are required for safety - no sandals or flip-flops. We recommend long pants, a hat, and sunglasses. Don’t forget sunscreen and insect repellent, plus bring your camera to capture the beautiful riverside scenery. services.name: Airboat Tour
services.desc: We recommend bringing sun protection including sunglasses and sunscreen, as you’ll be exposed to sun and wind during the ride. Hats are not recommended. If you don’t have sunglasses or sunscreen, they are available for purchase on-site. Don’t forget your camera to capture the exciting moments and wildlife encounters! Dress comfortably for outdoor conditions. All safety equipment is provided by us. We operate rain-or-shine! Our airboat tours run in most weather conditions, and many guests find that overcast or light rain actually enhances wildlife viewing as animals are more active. In case of severe weather conditions like lightning or dangerous storms, we’ll work with you to reschedule
